Live Experience

14-Day Live Experience

Explore Demo first. When you're ready, fund Live and experience Arbitrix for 14 days before the $7/month platform subscription becomes due.

14 days of free Live trading

Once your Live account is funded, your 14-day free Live experience begins — no platform subscription fee during this period.

Then $7/month to continue

After the 14-day period, a simple $7/month subscription keeps the platform running. Your trading capital stays separate and always yours.

e.g. BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT

e.g. EUR/USD

Stocks

Commodities

Availability of specific instruments is determined by the platform and is not a guarantee of execution on any specific asset.

Pricing

Arbitrix Pro

Arbitrix Pro
$7/month
No upfront subscription payment.
  • Explore Demo Mode at no cost, anytime.
  • Fund your Live account and trade with real funds.
  • 14-day Live experience before the subscription is due.
  • $7/month subscription, deducted from your available balance.

No card required for the subscription. The $7 is deducted from your available Live trading balance when due.

Trading capital vs. subscription fee

Your trading balance is your trading capital. The $7 monthly charge is the Arbitrix platform subscription fee, separate from your trading capital.

Your 14-day free Live period starts when you fund your Live account. After it ends, the first $7 is deducted, then $7 each month while the subscription is active.

If your available balance cannot cover the fee at billing time, no debt is created and your balance is never taken negative. The fee is retried on the next billing check; your funds remain available for trading and eligible withdrawals.

No card is ever required — the $7 is only ever deducted from your available platform balance.

Security

Security

Withdrawal / security controls

Activity tracking

In-app notifications keep you informed of transaction and account activity.

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Arbitrix is an automated multi-asset trading platform built around arbitrage. It monitors supported markets for qualifying price discrepancies and automates eligible trades.

Arbitrage takes advantage of a price discrepancy for the same or a related asset across different markets. Arbitrix identifies such opportunities among supported markets and automates execution.

Demo Mode lets you explore Arbitrix using virtual funds. It uses the same live market data as a Live account, so the result on Demo matches a Live account. Demo performance still does not guarantee Live performance.

No. Demo Mode uses virtual funds and does not use your real trading funds.

Switch to Live Mode in the dashboard, fund your Live account with USDT (TRC20), and start the bot once the applicable minimum balance is reached. Arbitrix then automates eligible trades with your real funds.

No. You can fund your Live account and trade free for 14 days. The $7/month subscription only begins after your 14-day Live period ends — no payment is required upfront, and no card is ever required.

Once you fund your Live account, you get 14 days of free Live trading at no subscription cost. After those 14 days, the $7/month subscription applies to keep using the platform.

The Arbitrix Pro subscription is $7/month, deducted from your available trading balance when due. Based on the current product model, there are no additional platform fees.

You can withdraw to your own wallet address whenever eligible. Requests are typically processed within approximately 15–30 minutes, and applicable verification/security checks may apply.

Risk Disclosure

Trading involves risk. Past performance — including performance in Demo Mode — is not indicative of future results and does not guarantee Live performance.

Arbitrix is not a guaranteed-income program, savings account, fixed-return investment, or promise of daily profits. You can lose money trading. Only trade with funds you can afford to lose.
